title: Damaged on arrival
body: If an item arrives damaged, the customer may choose a replacement or a full refund within 30 days of delivery. Photos help but are not required.

title: Wrong item shipped
body: When we ship the wrong item we send a prepaid return label and ship the correct item immediately.

title: Late delivery
body: Orders more than 5 days late qualify for a shipping refund. Orders still in transit cannot be refunded yet.

title: Changed my mind
body: Unused items can be returned within 30 days for store credit or a refund minus a 10% restocking fee.

title: Warranty claims
body: Gear failures within one year are covered by warranty; open a ticket so the warranty team can review.
